_comment: 728-F contract -> real-tool mapping (specs/728-EF.md D7). Per role: the same real name on two portals is two different server entries. `contract: null` = no contract verb (read-back or plan-authorized row; `basis` says which). `tool` is the CATALOG name; the served (include) name is `<server>_<tool>` for portal rows (see portal-readback/*.json). A tool named by a role's active phase set (role-configs.json) must have a row here, otherwise generate.py refuses to render it: that is gate (ii) of D6. `read_back_only: true` rows are verify-after-write surfaces and must never be classified write-capable (D8 item 3).
